analogy.rationale: Apoptosis stimulants acting via PYGM (glycogen phosphorylase) have no clear shared transcriptional program with most reference classes, and the annotated target suggests a metabolic rather than canonical death-receptor mechanism, so responses should be weak; caspase activators and BCL inhibitors are the closest death-pathway classes but act downstream and may show only partial overlap.
